build.description: Builds each package: tsup bundles plus type declarations for libraries, a Vite production build for apps/docs

build-storybook.description: Builds the static Storybook site for apps/docs into storybook-static/

lint.description: Lints source code: ESLint with the shared @repo/eslint-config for packages, oxlint for apps/docs

typecheck.description: Type-checks each package with tsc without emitting output

dev.description: Starts watch mode: rebuilds packages on change and serves apps/docs with Vite

clean.description: Deletes build output, the .turbo cache and node_modules in each package

test.description: Runs the Vitest unit test suite once

test:watch.description: Runs Vitest in watch mode, re-running tests on change
